text:
Ivy (People Ops): Quick update — auditors asked for an accelerated evidence snapshot. New hard cut for the upload portal: Mon 04/11 12:00 PT. Please read the FAQ below and follow the naming rules.

Omar (Security): Top-priority controls auditors called out: access controls, vendor assessments for data-handling vendors, and key management rotation proofs. Flag those first in the uploader.

Keisha (Eng): For access reviews: is a CSV export + one-line query description ok, or do you need UI screenshots too?

Omar (Security): CSV + one-line query and export timestamp is preferred. If only UI is available, include a screenshot plus the export query in a README. Example filename we will accept: `20260411-eng-access.csv`.

Ivy (People Ops): NEW filename pattern for this snapshot (automation will validate exactly):
```
<YYYYMMDD>-<team>-<control>.<ext>
examples:
20260411-eng-access.csv
20260411-legal-vendor.pdf
20260411-infra-kms.csv
```
The dash separators are required for this intake. Please also complete the upload form fields: control id, owner email, production=true/false. Uploader: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-uploader

Tom (Procurement): Procurement backlog — if a vendor packet is still pending, will a signed purchase order + procurement status email be acceptable as interim evidence?

Omar (Security): Yes — PO + procurement email with expected delivery date is acceptable as provisional evidence. Mark it "provisional" in the uploader and follow up with the signed questionnaire within 5 business days.

Keisha (Eng): Dashboards show relative timestamps ("2 hours ago"). Do we need absolute timestamps?

Omar (Security): Absolute timestamps required. If UI lacks them, include the exact query used and the run time in a one-line README.

reminder_bot: Reminder scheduled — "Accelerated evidence due Mon 04/11 12:00 PT". Will post in #people-ops and DM owners at 08:00 on due day.

Ivy (People Ops): Office hours this sprint: Fri 14:00-16:00 PT and Mon 09:00-11:00 PT. Join link on the compliance page. If you need 1:1 help, book a slot on my calendar.

Keisha (Eng): We have contractor audit logs hosted in a vendor portal. Can those be used if sponsor attests?

Omar (Security): Yes — sponsor attestation required. Upload sponsor email and check the "contractor_sponsored" box in the form. No anonymous exceptions.

Ivy (People Ops): Important automated checks: 1) filenames must match the dash pattern or ingestion will reject, 2) zips must be flat (no nested folders), 3) if you redact data, include a one-line note listing redacted fields. Late uploads become exceptions and add review time.

Tom (Procurement): I'll push provisional vendor packets this afternoon.

Keisha (Eng): Will aim to upload eng bundle Sun night.

Ivy (People Ops): Thanks all — ping #compliance-help or DM me if blocked. :pray:
